title: New World VR
specs: Over 150 VR game options including shooters, sports, fantasy, horror, musical, and art

blurb: Guests play virtual reality games in seated or arena setups with over 150 game options including shooters, sports, fantasy, horror, musical, and art games. The venue also offers pro flight and racing simulators, arcade games, and ping-pong. Private parties include exclusive venue access with all equipment and attendants for two hours.
extraNote: $50 nonrefundable deposit required for parties, applied to balance · Walk-ins welcome; online booking required for some days and recommended for weekends and holidays · Discounts for military, first responders, seniors, college students, teachers with ID or code LIVE · 4th player free for groups of four or more (walk-in only) · At the VR64 location inside Premium Outlets Norfolk, near Adidas on the North-Hampton side of the mall, second row of stores, across from the playground, beside the Uniform Outlet.
